purpose: Historical E0020 draft-PR checkpoint, read before this increment; not qualification of E0021 or its future head
title: Falsify coupled SPI mode-0 sampling and measure reference costs
body:
The existing manual SHIFT_STEP drives MOSI and samples synchronized RX on the same execution edge. An eight-word mode-0 program can generate the intended clock/CS/TX trace, yet it receives before late target data becomes visible. This PR freezes and tests that boundary before any production RTL expansion.

**The declared broad mode-0 response-envelope hypothesis FAILS for the tested schedule. Green regressions preserve the counterexample; they do not qualify SPI.** P-SPI-HOST-4MODE (1 MHz, modes 0-3, both bit orders/full duplex/CS boundaries) remains NOT_EVALUATED.

### Evidence and change

- A precise partial mode-0 contract, mathematical external pin oracle and real public-pin-loaded eight-word firmware witness. Every output/direction and exact 20,000 ps clock spacing is checked; result reads use the dedicated runtime path.
- At H=25, target RX `0x69` with response 89 quarter-ticks becomes raw `0xb4` in MSB-first operation, despite 55 ns of target input setup before rising SCK. Both Icarus and Verilator reproduce it. LSB-first gives `0xd3`. Boundary d=88 succeeds; d=89 and d=96 fail. The early-shift control fails even at d=1; all-ones masks the error.
- A separate unencoded DRIVE/SAMPLE reference consumes the intended raw rising-edge bit two execution edges later. It handles every RX byte in both orders at d=96 and retains 403 accepted edges, but needs **10 words/320 used bits**, versus 8/256.
- The real loader rejects length ten and its five-bit byte window cannot address 40 bytes. A simple reference guard adds one Boolean; this is not a physical flop/minimum-state result. Encodings, legacy/new shift interoperability, loader banking, synthesized gate/area/timing cost and architecture selection remain open.
- Production RTL, pins/config, 6x4 allocation, learning record and all visualizer source/data remain byte-identical to base `ae13f6bfcfd3fe21cd937768bc9e1151f441379c`.
- Normal regression includes the new SPI groups and requires them in waveform provenance. Focused runs can use `COCOTB_PLUSARGS=+NO_DUMP` to avoid overwriting full-regression dumps; default dump behavior remains enabled.
- State/backlog now reflect merged PR9 and the current partial SPI experiment. PR8 and compiler deferrals are preserved.

Current published head: **`463cc1e1c270018b8b63378f057deeeca51d6ee0`**.

### Focused local validation

- Existing locked-image Doctor PASS; no image build/pull, dependency install or storage cleanup.
- `make check` PASS: **31 Python cases** (18 M1 +3 UART +6 SPI +4 waveform provenance) plus metadata/learning/evidence consistency.
- Focused public-pin RTL: **2/2 groups PASS on each Icarus and Verilator**, including ten conditional/counterexample transfers, reset/disable/reload and actual ten-word capacity rejection. These are filtered tests, not a local full RTL regression.
- `node tools/export_atlas.mjs --check` PASS; protected-scope diff empty; committed source/log/JUnit/counterexample hashes and links verified.
- `python test/test_spi_mode0_oracle.py --require-mode0` deliberately exits **1** with the retained FAIL result. This is the rejected hypothesis, not a hidden passing SPI test.
- Initial runner/import/dump-placement issues are recorded. Raw logs are retained under ignored build/; curated logs normalize LF/trailing whitespace only and retain failed outcomes.

[Contract](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/blob/463cc1e1c270018b8b63378f057deeeca51d6ee0/docs/specs/p-spi-host-mode0.md), [D21](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/blob/463cc1e1c270018b8b63378f057deeeca51d6ee0/docs/decisions/0021-spi-phase-feasibility-before-rtl.md), [E0020 evidence](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/blob/463cc1e1c270018b8b63378f057deeeca51d6ee0/evidence/E0020-spi-mode0-feasibility/README.md), [counterexample](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/blob/463cc1e1c270018b8b63378f057deeeca51d6ee0/evidence/E0020-spi-mode0-feasibility/counterexample.json).

Fresh PR atlas evidence: **18 source/model passes**, including the 8,192-edge JS/Python comparison, and **15 Chromium passes**, zero skipped/unexpected/flaky and no report errors. [Artifact 13255088788](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/actions/runs/41686836860/artifacts/13255088788) was inspected in memory (3,400,524 bytes); independently computed ZIP SHA-256 `b3725ff1c4fe1a560b84d83201f41064f828b6edd9a5009c4dedfc40feecba5b` matches GitHub metadata. It names synthetic merge checkout `a04bfd6df6ff60d01a15d00dfb558e94b366313e`, not a merge into main. Both full repository workflows completed successfully, including evidence collection/upload. Logs from each show **19 RTL groups PASS on each simulator**, including the retained SPI failures, plus the 31-case Python/static path, waveform provenance, formal and generic synthesis. These are full regression outcomes, distinct from the local two-group filtered runs.

### Scope and next step

Draft simulation/research slice only. No merge, production hardware/RTL/ISA/storage change, compiler work, PR8 import/rebase/integration, deployment, security setting change, physical flow or owner-fluency promotion.

Next: freeze isolated phase-separated encodings and compare a compact eight-word alternative against the ten-word/banked-loader candidate under the same response oracle, including complete-chip costs. This result is not a proof that every possible eight-word program is impossible.

Interpretation: retaining the existing eight-word schedule under an explicitly faster target-response contract remains a zero-production-RTL alternative for scoped mode-0 work. This result does not prove that all useful SPI needs an extension, nor establish which physical devices/boards meet the bound. The fair comparison must keep input assumptions explicit; the rejected 20 ns-setup envelope cannot be silently narrowed into a PASS.
